messages:
Maya: Quick copy review for the new 'AI Assist' toggle in Console. Two concerns: the tooltip is vague about data use, and the disabled state label 'Turn on' feels casual. Thoughts?
Devon: Agree on the data bit — we need explicit, accurate wording about logs. Also prefer 'Enable' over 'Turn on'.
Lisa: We can't claim 'not logged' unless legal ok. Maybe 'queries aren’t stored after processing' is risky.
Tom: Ops/legal note: diagnostic logs include prompts for 7 days for debugging. We can state that and also that data isn't used for model training.
Maya: Draft tooltip attempt (short): 'Enable AI-powered suggestions. Diagnostic logs retained 7 days; not used for model training.' Is that too long?
Devon: Length's okay if it's concise. UX goal: ~100 chars. This is 93 chars — looks fine.
Lisa: Accessibility: aria-label should be explicit and dynamic, e.g. `aria-label="Enable AI Assist, currently off"`. Also tooltip must be keyboard-focusable, not hover-only.
DesignBot: A11y checklist: tooltip appears on focus, has role="tooltip", and the toggle has an accessible name. Contrast for the inline 'Learn more' link passes.
Tom: Also need copy for org-level enable confirmation. Ops/legal requested an explicit line about logs and training. Proposal: title 'Enable AI Assist for this organization?' body: 'AI Assist provides contextual suggestions and completions. Prompt text may be retained in diagnostic logs for up to 7 days; it will not be used for model training. Administrators can disable AI Assist at any time.' Add a 'Learn more' link to privacy docs.
Maya: That reads fine. Could we make the confirmation body shorter with clear bullets: Benefits / Logging / Controls? Maybe: 'AI Assist gives contextual suggestions. Diagnostic logs may include prompt text for 7 days; not used for model training. Admins can disable at any time.'
Devon: Button copy: Primary = 'Enable AI Assist' Secondary = 'Cancel'. For the org prompt add a small inline note: 'This setting applies to all projects in the org.'
Lisa: For the toggle label in compact views, use 'AI Assist' (short). Tooltip expands with the longer sentence and 'Learn more'.
Maya: Final checklist for copy pass: 1) Tooltip: 'Enable AI-powered suggestions. Diagnostic logs retained 7 days; not used for model training.' 2) Toggle aria-label sample included in spec. 3) Org confirm dialog body as above + 'Learn more' link. 4) Button labels: 'Enable AI Assist' / 'Cancel'. 5) Add inline note about org-wide effect where applicable.
Tom: I'll confirm precise legal phrasing on 'not used for model training' and get back. If legal changes, we'll update tooltip and dialog copy accordingly.
Maya: Thanks — leaving this for the copy pass. Ping me when legal signs off. :eyes:
